status_model.skeleton: Module surface exists; critical methods are placeholders or unwired
status_model.unit: Local unit behavior works; not multi-peer / not security-hardened
status_model.integrated: Wired into EdgeMesh data path for multi-peer use
status_model.hardened: Authz + signature checks on wire + CI green

summary.notes: Recalibrado 2026-10-15 con la suite unit real: 39 archivos / 236 tests PASS. Todos siguen 'partial' (maturity 'unit'): el nivel 'hardened' exige CI green y CI esta bloqueado por billing. Avg 76.0%.
